How we write prompts for our support bot

Our team keeps the system prompt short. The current version reads:

You are a friendly support assistant for Example Widgets. Answer questions about orders and shipping. If you don't know, say so and offer to connect the customer with a person.

We review it every quarter and keep a changelog.

text:
# Prompting notes

A good instruction is specific. Compare:

> Summarise this.

with

> Summarise this report in three bullet points for a manager who has two minutes.

The second tells the model the length, the format and the reader. Write prompts the way you would brief a new colleague.

Lesson 4: role prompts

In the exercise, students wrote role prompts such as "Act as a travel agent and plan a two-day trip to a city of your choice" and compared the answers. Discuss: why did the role change the tone of the reply?

Resetting your router

Unplug the router and wait thirty seconds. Plug it back in and wait for the light to turn green. If the light stays orange, hold the reset button for ten seconds. Note: a reset removes your Wi-Fi name and password, so write them down first.

html:
How phishing emails try to steal codes

Security researchers say scam emails often pretend to be a bank and ask for one-time codes. Banks never ask for these codes by email. If you get such a message, don't reply; report it to your bank using the number on your card.

A survey of indirect prompt injection

Indirect prompt injection happens when an AI assistant reads content that contains instructions written by an attacker. The paper groups defenses into three kinds: separating data from instructions, limiting what the assistant can do, and asking a person before sensitive actions.
